resources.string: Choose a feature to begin. More on-device tools can be added here.
Detect people, animals, birds, vehicles, and everyday objects live and offline.
Choose wildlife or people to watch for, hear an alert, and automatically capture a photo.
What should Ride Alert watch for?
Detection stays offline. An annotated photo is saved whenever a selected target triggers an alert. Mount the phone securely and make selections before beginning your ride.
